title: `elicitation/create` (URL)
description: A server request that sends the user out of band to a URL, for interactions such as sign-in that must not pass through the client.
question: Can the framework hand a user off to an external URL and resume?
why: Form mode is explicitly forbidden from collecting credentials, so URL mode is the sanctioned path for sign-in flows. A framework that implements only form mode leaves servers with no compliant way to authenticate a user mid-task.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: at 2026-07-28 the request arrives embedded in an `InputRequiredResult`. The adapter has no elicitation hook and calls tools through the MCP SDK's default `call_tool`, so the SDK's `Server returned InputRequiredResult` error reaches the caller as an `AgentsException` and nothing is answered.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): at 2026-07-28 the request arrives embedded in an `InputRequiredResult`. The client rejects any result with `resultType: "input_required"` ("multi round-trip requests are not supported yet"), so `execute` throws and nothing is answered. The registered `onElicitationRequest` handler never runs. At 2025-11-25 the same handler refuses URL mode because its schema requires `requestedSchema`. Kept `u` for that reason; `mrtr-input-required` carries the `n`.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0 at 2026-07-28: the server answers with `input_required`, and the MCP client the SDK builds tries to fulfil it itself, but no `elicitation/create` handler is registered on it and the SDK offers no option to add one. The call fails with `Cannot fulfil input request`, which the agent hands the model as tool-error text.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` builds its fastmcp `Client` with no elicitation handler and exposes no hook to add one, so URL elicitation is refused.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy takes no elicitation handler. The server's request is answered only by a `elicitation_callback` registered on the caller's own `mcp.Client`, which DSPy is handed by `Tool.from_mcp_tool` and never configures. DSPy itself offers no route.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): at 2026-07-28 the request arrives embedded in an `input_required` result. The runtime fails to parse one carrying a URL-mode request ("expected CallToolResult from tools/call, got CustomResult(...)"), the tool call fails, and `SessionConfig.onElicitationRequest` never runs. At 2025-11-25 the same handler answers URL mode.
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: at 2026-07-28 `DefaultMcpClient` reads an `InputRequiredResult` and throws `Server sent inputRequests that the client cannot handle`, whatever is embedded. No hook answers it, so the tool call fails.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): mcptoolset has no elicitation option. A `mcp.ClientOptions.ElicitationHandler` with `Capabilities.Elicitation.URL` set on the `*mcp.Client` the caller passes as `mcptoolset.Config.Client` answers the server's request, so it works, but only by configuring go-sdk rather than the toolset.
